purpose: Repair missing independent TRAIN future supervision at states visited by the current frozen model; diagnose conditional versus accumulated rollout bias before more training.
source: warm seed11 checkpoint step72144; TRAIN parents only; branch0 at 0.3 and 0.8 ps; fixed index selection, no outcome filtering
physics: Unchanged registered Bauer open L16 Hamiltonian, temperature and MT5.9 solver from original parent configs
training: No new training in this campaign. Freeze three existing warm checkpoints. New TRAIN bank is separate from independent probe/fine branches.
comparators: Same frozen checkpoints at real LLG TRAIN states, already evaluated against independent futures; common seed11 model states used by all checkpoints.
uncertainty: Whole independent branches bootstrap100 per state; parent-correlated aggregate descriptive, reference-reference control not acceptance threshold.
limitations: State distributions differ; errors are diagnostic, not unique causal proof. Only seed11 sees its own rollout states. No rare-event gates or physical certification from execution.
runtime_estimate: Each reference parent 1-3 min preliminary, GPU diagnostic 15-30 min preliminary, stats 3-6 min. Confirm via short smoke; queue excluded.
policy: All experimental artifacts under tests; no production promotion. Submit formal dependency chain and stop monitoring after acceptance.
